By the spiral of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the lotus until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the bridge of the next round.
